name: Flamenco trio for a private dinner: Dirty Flamenco, live
description: Dirty Flamenco plays traditional flamenco and rumba at a private dinner. The trio is flamenco guitar, bass and cajón (a wooden box drum).
more: If you'd like a featured performance in your program, we can add a dancer to the trio. Just let us know where you'd like it in the flow of the evening. The rest of the time, the trio can play quietly through cocktails and dinner.
